status: Known analytic primary response preparation; not endpoint data or admission
units: DOS Nlambda=N0(1+lambda/4), N0 positive; source Tc subtraction; positive Matsubara zlambda=omega+i delta; Omega=sqrt(z^2+Delta^2), ReOmega>0
relative_trajectory_shift: p=vF khat dot K; Gplus/minus radialxi shifted by plus/minus p/2

radial_integrals.I2: integral xi^2 dxi over the same denominator=pi/(2Omega)

renormalized_kernel.M_PP: 2N0 ln(T/Tc0)+4piT N0 sum 1/omega -8piT sum_{lambda,omega} Nlambda Re<Omega_lambda/[4Omega_lambda^2+p^2]>

regularization: Combine common counterterm before sum. Analytic high-frequency remainder and separate Matsubara/angular convergence required. This analytic radial integration avoids a new radial quadrature or cutoff parameter.

known_zero_field_stationary_checks.phase: M_PP/N0=4piT sum <p^2/[Omega(4Omega^2+p^2)]>, hence zero at K0 and nonnegative otherwise
known_zero_field_stationary_checks.cross: M_AP=0 by angular parity at zero field/zero q
known_zero_field_stationary_checks.smallK: At stationary Delta and after amplitude relaxation, Delta^2 Mphase_effective/K^2 approaches d^2F/dq^2=sourcejprime/2 for matching direction and units.

independent_check_needed: Independent Fourier-ordering/vertex trace and source Ward check requested from materials_review. No finite-field numerical data generated.

supersedes.reason: Make conjugate-row Fourier ordering explicit; raw GplusVA GminusVP coefficient is the transposed physical AP entry.

Fourier_convention: a(r)=aK exp(iKr)+aK* exp(-iKr), b likewise. Quadratic matrix rows (aK*,bK*), columns(aK,bK), so AP uses Gminus VA Gplus VP, not raw Gplus VA Gminus VP.
mixed_smallK_control: M_AP/(iK)=F_qDelta/Delta= -piT sum Nlambda vF costheta Im(zlambda/Omega_lambda^3), for K along sourceq. This fixes physical row/column/eigenvector convention; not merely arbitrary sign.
